title: Choose direct sowing or transplanting
summary: Use the method that protects the crop’s roots and fits the season.
steps: Direct-sow crops that resent root disturbance or are normally grown closely in place, following packet guidance.
Start slow warm-season crops indoors only when adequate light, space and later outdoor conditions exist.
Do not keep seedlings so long that roots circle heavily or plants become pale and stretched.
Prepare the final bed before moving seedlings and water the root ball.
Record which method produced faster establishment and lower loss locally.
